g.text: Agent: I opened the staging login page; it needs your SSO sign-in.
Live picture of the tab in view (clicks, wheel, typing go to
Live picture of the tab in view
Switch on a Chromium of this session’s own: the agent drives it with its browser tools, and you watch and use it here at the same time, on the same tabs. You can log in for the agent or
take over a step and hand back with a message.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

There is no pane header. The compact top bar is the screen's own: tabs and ＋ (New tab) on the left. Docked, the right side has Open in a separate window (⧉), More (⋯), Expand over the conversation (⤢) and Close the browser (✕).
Detached, it has Dock beside the conversation, More and Close the window.

⋯ menu: the tabs that do not fit (when there is more than one), then Reload F5 and Close this tab, then Switch the browser off… or Start the browser, then Open in a separate window or Dock beside the conversation.
The docked column defaults to 45% of the space beside the sessions sidebar. Drag the divider to resize it.
The detached window is titled "<tab title> · <conversation title>".
A Read-only token sees "Watching only: this token cannot act in the browser." under the address bar, and the controls are greyed out.
Switching it off asks "Switch the browser off?" (Switch off). While switched on but not running, it says "The browser is switched on but not running".
Right-clicking a tab offers Show this tab and Close this tab. Ctrl+L goes to the address field (cue: "Enter a web address").
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
